inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A wide strip of a pixel art game background: a high plateau above a sea of white clouds. Across a deep gap stands a pale lavender flat topped hill, and on it, seen from far away, is a crowded settlement in rows that recede up the hill, big buildings at the near edge and smaller, paler ones behind them: the camp of the Bloodridge, desert guardians in the manner of ancient Egypt: a dark stone temple gate of two sloped pylon towers with ember light in its doorway, a stepped pyramid of dark stone, tall dark obelisks with thin glowing ember cracks, low tents of sepia and ash brown rags, bronze braziers, two bronze catapults standing at the hill's corner over the gap, ragged banners with a dark red sun disc on poles. The mood is ash brown, sepia and corroded bronze with ember light. Everything on the hill is small with distance, seen from far across the gap, with clear readable silhouettes against the white clouds behind it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a real lived in settlement seen from afar, coherent pixel clusters, depth and scale, readable silhouettes",
